Embark on your motherhood journey with Swisse Ultinatal Pre-Conception & Pregnancy Multivitamin, a comprehensive blend of 19 nutrients designed to support you throughout your pregnancy and beyond. This formula, featuring 500 mcg of folic acid per daily dose, omega-3 DHA, choline, and vitamin D, is tailored to support the heightened nutritional demands before, during, and after pregnancy. It contains key nutrients to help prepare your body for pregnancy as well as nutrients such as choline, iodine, zinc and DHA to support healthy foetal development. The inclusion of a low-constipation form of iron which is gentle on your stomach, makes it a helpful companion during this special time.

This product is not suitable for Vegan or Vegetarian diets as it is encapsulated in a bovine gelatine capsule.

Benefits

Comprehensive blend for pre-conception and pregnancy

19 nutrients, including folic acid

Choline, iodine and zinc supports baby's development

Gentle, low-constipation iron

Directions + Warnings

Adult Dosage:

Two capsules daily, during or immediately after a meal, or as directed by a healthcare professional.

Warnings:

Advise your doctor of any medicine you take during pregnancy, particularly in your first trimester.

Do not exceed the stated dose except on medical advice.

If you have had a baby with a neural tube defect/spina bifida, seek specific medical advice.

Not for the treatment of iron deficiency conditions.

This product contains selenium, which is toxic in high doses.

A daily dose of 150 mcg for adults of selenium from dietary supplements should not be exceeded.

Vitamin supplements should not replace a balanced diet.

If symptoms persist consult your healthcare professional.

This medicine may not be right for you. Always read the label and any warnings before purchase. Follow the directions for use. If symptoms persist, talk to your health professional. Supplements may only be of assistance if dietary intake is inadequate.

Storage:

Store below 25°C. Do not use if cap seal is broken.

Allergen Information

Contains soya bean, sugar alcohols and sulfites. No added lactose, gluten, yeast, egg, artificial flavours or colours.

Ingredients

Each soft capsule contains:

Folic acid 250 micrograms

Choline (from choline bitartrate) 22.62 mg

Concentrated fish Omega-3 triglycerides 250mg

Containing: eicosapentaenoic acid 37.5 mg; docosahexaenoic acid 125 mg

Biotin 15 micrograms

Vitamin B1 (thiamine from thiamine nitrate) 700 micrograms

Vitamin B2 (riboflavin) 700 micrograms

Nicotinamide 9 mg

Vitamin B5 (pantothenic acid from calcium pantothenate) 2.5 mg

Vitamin B6 (pyridoxine from pyridoxine hydrochloride) 950 micrograms

Mecobalamin (co-methylcobalamin) 1.31 micrograms

Vitamin C (ascorbic acid from sodium ascorbate) 30 mg

Vitamin D3 (colecalciferol) 12.5 micrograms

Vitamin E (d-alpha-tocopherol) 3.5 mg

Calcium (from calcium citrate tetrahydrate) 25 mg

Iodine (from potassium iodide) 110 micrograms

Iron (from iron II glycinate) 5 mg

Magnesium (from heavy magnesium oxide) 25 mg

Selenium (from selenomethionine) 32.5 micrograms

Zinc (from zinc amino acid chelate) 5.50 mg

FAQ

Can I take Swisse products if I have a medical condition or take medication?

We recommend consulting your Primary Healthcare Professional for more advice regarding the suitability of any supplement, particularly if there is an underlying health condition or if you are taking pharmaceutical medications.

Can I take this product alongside other products in the Swisse range?

We always recommend consulting your Primary Healthcare Professional when taking multiple supplements alongside each other or when considering changes to your supplementary routine, particularly if you are taking pharmaceutical medication.

Is this product suitable for long term use?

We do not anticipate any challenges with taking this product long-term however, we advise that you intermittently consult your Primary Healthcare Provider to reassess the suitability of any supplementation taken on a long-term basis.

Is this product suitable for everybody during pregnancy?

Whilst these formulations are developed to support a healthy pregnancy, we suggest that you consult your Primary Healthcare Professional when considering your supplement routine during this time for individualised advice.

Benefits of Thorne’s Basic Prenatal at each stage:

Pre-Conception

• Daily multi-vitamin/mineral support for a woman of childbearing age.

First Trimester

Third Trimester

• Provides the extra nutrients needed for continued healthy fetal development and to prepare mom and baby for birth.*

After Pregnancy through Nursing

• Nutritional support for increased demand for calcium and vitamin D in the diet.

  • Clinically proven absorption of Folic Acid & Iron

This complete multivitamin and mineral formula provides balanced daily nutritional support with essential vitamins and minerals. KEY BENEFITS

Take 12 capsules daily with meals or as directed by a healthcare professional.



HOW TO USE

Consult a healthcare professional before use.

Store in a cool, dry place.
